channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: U.S. economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July
item.description: Nonfarm payrolls were projected to increase by 83,000 in July while the unemployment rate would hold steady at 4.2%, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

item.title: Cassidy supports Todd Blanche, rescuing Trump's embattled attorney general pick
item.description: Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche needs at least 50 votes on the Senate floor to be confirmed after clearing the Senate Judiciary Committee.

item.title: Rockstar Energy founder builds Celsius stake, wants to take over as CEO
item.description: Rockstar Energy founder Russ Savage told CNBC he now controls 12 million shares of Celsius Holdings, amounting to roughly 4.7% of the energy drink company.

item.title: S&P 500 rises as it wraps up banner week with traders seeing bright side of dismal jobs report: Live updates
item.description: Wall Street is coming off a losing session as the July jobs report looms.

item.title: Shares of this digital medical platform jumped more than 100% overnight. Here’s why
item.description: The company is seeing huge profitability potential and a larger addressable market as a result of AI search.

item.title: Applied Materials is about to report earnings. How to trade the AI picks-and-shovels play ahead of results
item.description: Even as the stock has more than doubled in 2026, the outlook is still strong for the wafer fab equipment giant.

item.title: Crypto’s infrastructure era arrives, with AI agents poised to reshape demand
item.description: Crypto companies are trying to build a second growth engine by turning agents into the next wave of users.

item.title: U.S. appeals court blocks Trump’s $400 million White House ballroom project
item.description: The appeals court placed its ruling on hold for 14 days to allow the Trump administration to appeal to the U.S. Supreme Court.

item.title: Iran's chief negotiator accuses Trump of 'theater diplomacy' with Hormuz traffic near standstill
item.description: The conflict is broadening across the region, with Gulf energy infrastructure and key shipping choke points under renewed threat.

item.title: SpaceX shares upgraded. Argus says AI investments will pay off, and don't bet against Musk
item.description: SpaceX could continue to bounce back as investments in artificial intelligence begin to pay off, according to Argus.

item.title: K-shaped economy shows up in housing: Luxury sales rise as starter-home buyers struggle
item.description: Even as luxury homes fly off the market, sales of starter homes are down despite growing inventory and more price cuts, research shows.

item.title: Homes are selling below asking in 38 of the 50 biggest U.S. cities—if you can afford one
item.description: Home sellers in many of the largest U.S. cities are accepting offers below asking as higher mortgage rates squeeze buyers' budgets.

item.title: Companies scoff at airlines' cheapest business class tickets. 'The real value is flexibility'
item.description: Some companies plan to shun the cheapest business- and premium- economy fares from their executives.

item.title: GAO finds Elon Musk's DOGE inflated claims of $110 billion in savings for federal government
item.description: The nonpartisan watchdog found Elon Musk's DOGE didn't cut as much federal spending as it claimed and that it fell far short of its promised $2 trillion.

item.title: Whatnot valued at $20 billion as live shopping continues to boom
item.description: Whatnot, the live commerce platform, has increased its valuation to $20 billion as the popularity of live shopping continues to grow.

item.title: JPMorgan upgrades Etsy, sees turnaround story taking stock another 20% higher
item.description: Etsy reported strong sales growth during its second-quarter earnings report this week, which could give its stock more room to run, per JPMorgan.

item.title: Martha's Vineyard African American Film Festival set for record attendance despite macro challenges
item.description: MVAAFF founder Floyd Rance says the festival has found a sustainable audience on the Massachusetts island, helping it weather macroeconomic uncertainty.

item.title: SK Hynix to invest $38 billion building new memory chip plants as demand soars
item.description: Memory prices have surged because of short supply and huge demand with investors watching closely for any changes to the supply-demand imbalance.

item.title: Volkswagen controlling families call for faster overhaul to fend off Chinese rivals
item.description: Volkswagen's top investor on Friday called on the auto giant to take immediate action to fend off intensifying competition from Chinese car brands.

item.title: Private equity is circling budget airlines after Apollo's EasyJet deal — and this carrier could be next
item.description: Private equity investors could target more undervalued airlines following Apollo's swoop for EasyJet.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Friday
item.description: The July jobs was a big miss, and shares of Atlassian are rising after a strong quarter.

item.title: What is a data breach? The best tools to protect yourself after a cyberattack
item.description: Cybersecurity incidents have reached record highs in the U.S. What does it mean if you've been caught up in a data breach — and how can you get help?

item.title: Analysis: Trump treats Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh as an ally. That creates economic risks
item.description: Trump's reported phone calls to the Fed chairman will complicate his efforts to prove he will act independently on inflation and interest rates.

item.title: AMD buys chip startup that hardwires AI models into its silicon
item.description: Taalas' current chip runs a small version of Meta's Llama 3.1, though the company is working on chips for bigger and more advanced models.

item.title: Virginia governor to intervene in NextEra, Dominion merger over electricity price concerns
item.description: Virginia's State Corporation Commission is tasked with reviewing the deal and will either accept, reject or impose conditions on it.

item.title: China is gaining ground in AI. But the U.S. still has a major advantage
item.description: Chinese AI companies have made recent leaps in closing the performance gap with U.S. frontier labs.

item.title: Grindr's AI spend is paying off and its pricey new tier has had some surprises, CEO says
item.description: Grindr says AI is boosting engineering productivity, supporting a new $350-per-month premium tier and driving stronger subscriber growth and retention.

item.title: Fox won't renegotiate NFL media rights before current deal expires, CEO Lachlan Murdoch says
item.description: Fox has decided not to renegotiate its current TV deal with the NFL until the expiration of the league's opt-out clause in 2030, said CEO Lachlan Murdoch.

item.title: Meta ordered to pay $567 million into abatement fund as remedy to child harms case in New Mexico
item.description: A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay $567 million into an abatement fund after a jury ruled the company violated the state’s unfair practices act.

item.title: Gas prices could remain high this fall even if crude prices stabilize. Here's why
item.description: The refining market is very tight due to the Ukraine and Iran wars, keeping gas prices elevated even as crude prices fall.
